mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.0% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue growth expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% YoY), a federal funds rate decline signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS declines > 0.1pp from prior month
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS declines > 0.1pp, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production decline below 110.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 110.0 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts above 1,050.0 thousand units in a single month signals strong housing market activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1050.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production expansion above 110.0 for three consecutive months indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 110.0 for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE >= 5.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls below 137,000 thousand signals worsening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE >= 5.5% and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE >= 5.5% and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% from prior month.
